commit.message:
Spell the retired names in the tests that cover them.

Escaping those names kept a literal grep empty, and one rewrite made to avoid the word could no longer fail. A node-project audit now allows each remaining occurrence by file and reason.

Name the Git 2.54 task that repacks the fabricated repo.

Two loose objects in objects/17 do trigger geometric-repack, and one does not. gc.auto is not that switch: 0 and 6700 both still repack. maintenance.auto=false is the line that stops it.

Point the server lens check at the radio that is actually checked.

The markup never renders a data-lens attribute, so asserting its absence could not fail. The checked Poster or Ledger radio is the decode the server renders.

Record the smoke landmark and correct the ideas rows this review closed.

The preview checker now looks for Jump to today, which is what later previews will be held to. Rows 10 and 11 still described removed work as open, and row 116 still gave Broadcast a dark default.

v0.5.4 — extra time and penalties are finals of their own (#316)

ESPN's STATUS_FINAL_AET and STATUS_FINAL_PEN are stored as after_extra_time and after_penalties, with ESPN's score and, for a penalty final, the shootout. One such result no longer refuses the snapshot for every league. A finished row reads AET or PENS and never FT, and the form guide still counts only a full-time result. A change from one final status to another is urgent at any horizon, and a correction of the shootout alone is an urgent result change. A final whose score or shootout is missing or malformed, or whose shootout is level, is refused, and that refuses the whole snapshot.

Built and rebutted by Cursor, reviewed cold by Claude; Pass 2.5 and the re-read ran on GPT-6.1 Sol. Not done: a 90-minute score (docs/v0.2.6-ideas.md row 118) and containing an unknown status to its own competition (row 119). The merge day moved from Mon 16 Nov to Sat 14 Nov 2026 on Beni's word.

A match may go long. The sync no longer stops for it.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
